> Technical Issue During OPPE Exam - Question 1 Evaluation and Progress Deletion

@22F3002354 @Subendu @sushil1

I am writing to bring to your attention a technical issue I encountered during the recent OPPE exam, which impacted my performance.

During the exam, I completed Question 1 and verified my solution using the synchro eval command. At that time, all test cases passed, and the question was successfully marked as submitted. However, after working on other questions, I decided to re-run the synchro eval command for Question 1 as a precautionary check. To my surprise, this led to the deletion of the directories and files I had created for the question, and the test cases failed as a result. Unfortunately, this issue occurred towards the end of the examination, leaving me with no time to recover my progress.

I immediately informed the proctor, but they seem to be unfamiliar with how to resolve the issue.

Given that this technical issue could directly affected my performance, I would appreciate your guidance on how to proceed or if there is any possibility to re-evaluate my work.

Thank you for your attention to this matter.

Regards
Arnajit Chakraborty
